seasons.overview: It's the dawning of a new era in NXT as the gold and black brand finds a home at Full Sail University, crowns its first champion, and kicks off the WWE careers of Seth Rollins, Cesaro, Roman Reigns, and more.

seasons.name: Season 8
seasons.overview: The future is now as NXT makes its mark with its first live specials taking over WWE Network. Paige, Kevin Owens, Rusev & Lana, Charlotte Flair, and more up-and-coming WWE Superstars highlight 2014 in NXT.

seasons.name: Season 9
seasons.overview: Finn Bálor, Bayley, Samoa Joe, Becky Lynch, and more future WWE Superstars make 2015 one of the most historic years in NXT. Featuring the first NXT TakeOver: Brooklyn and inaugural Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic.

seasons.name: Season 10
seasons.overview: Strong style takes over NXT in 2016 as Shinsuke Nakamura joins the brand and Asuka's undefeated streak carries her to the NXT Women's Championship. Featuring Bayley, Samoa Joe, No Way Jose, Finn Bálor, and more

seasons.name: Season 11
seasons.overview: Chaos reigns supreme in NXT during 2017 as the Undisputed Era makes its mark, SAnitY runs amok, Ember Moon succeeds Asuka, Bobby Roode is glorious, the United Kingdom Championship debuts, and so much more.

seasons.name: Season 12
seasons.overview: Darkness falls over NXT in 2018 as Aleister Black, Tommaso Ciampa, Shayna Baszler, and War Raiders loom over the brand. Plus, Velveteen Dream, Johnny Gargano, Ricochet, and more help take NXT to the next level.

seasons.name: Season 13
seasons.overview: The future is now! In 2019 on NXT heated rivalries like Johnny Gargano vs. Adam Cole take center stage while the Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic Tournament returns. All this and much more action.

results.overview:
WWE Velocity was a professional wrestling television program produced by World Wrestling Entertainment. It replaced two syndicated WWE shows, Jakked/Metal. Once a weekly Saturday night show on Spike TV and on Sky Sports 2 in the UK on Sunday mornings, Velocity became a webcast from 2005 to 2006. The newest episode would be uploaded to WWE.com on Saturdays and be available for the next week. Older webcast episodes were also archived. It was the counterpart show to WWE SmackDown and WWE Raw and was recorded before the television taping of SmackDown.

Get up to speed on the week's high-octane events from the SmackDown brand and see exclusive matches only on WWE Velocity.
results.name: WWE Velocity

results.overview:
Hogan Knows Best is an American reality documentary television series on VH1. The series debuted on July 10, 2005 and centered on the family life of professional wrestler Hulk Hogan. Often focusing on the Hogans' raising of their children, and on Hulk Hogan's attempts to manage and assist in his children's burgeoning careers. The title of the show is a play on the title of a show from the 1950s, Father Knows Best.

After the cancellation of Hogan Knows Best in 2007, a spin-off entitled Brooke Knows Best debuted in 2008, and ran for two seasons.
results.name: Hogan Knows Best

results.overview: Jerry Jarrett's Continental Wrestling Assocation (CWA) Wrestling show on WMC-TV, later renamed to "Championship Wrestling Association" and keeping the same CWA name around the time Jerry Lawler joined Jerry Jarrett in running the show. After Jarrett and Lawler purchased the rights to World Class Wrestling Association's "World Class Championship Wrestling" shows in the Dallas area, both the Dallas shows and the CWA show were rebranded under the "United States Wrestling Association" name. This show was rebranded to "USWA Championship Wrestling." The show ended in 1997.
results.name: USWA Championship Wrestling
